id-20260927-news-1.title: October Non-Subsidized Fuel Prices Predicted to Rise up to 11 Percent, Singapore Oil Price Surge is the Trigger

segments.src: Harga bahan bakar minyak (BBM) nonsubsidi pada Oktober diproyeksikan naik hingga sekitar 11 persen.
segments.tr: Non-subsidized fuel prices in October are projected to rise by up to around 11 percent.

segments.src: Pemicu utamanya adalah kenaikan harga acuan produk minyak olahan di Singapura, yang dikenal sebagai MOPS (*Mean of Platts Singapore*).
segments.tr: The main trigger is the increase in the benchmark price of refined oil products in Singapore, known as MOPS (*Mean of Platts Singapore*).

segments.src: Di saat yang sama, ketegangan di Selat Hormuz dan Laut Merah membuat pelaku usaha transportasi dan logistik ikut mencermati dampaknya terhadap biaya operasional.
segments.tr: At the same time, tensions in the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea have caused transportation and logistics business actors to closely monitor their impact on operational costs.

segments.src: Artikel ini merangkum proyeksi yang beredar, penjelasan singkat tentang cara harga BBM terbentuk, serta hal-hal yang perlu diperhatikan konsumen dan pelaku usaha.
segments.tr: This article summarizes circulating projections, a brief explanation of how fuel prices are formed, as well as things consumers and business actors need to pay attention to.

segments.src: Seluruh angka di bawah ini bersifat **proyeksi**, bukan pengumuman resmi.
segments.tr: All figures below are **projections**, not official announcements.

segments.src: ## Apa yang Berubah pada Harga Acuan?
segments.tr: ## What Changes in the Benchmark Price?

segments.src: Harga acuan MOPS diperkirakan naik dari sekitar **US$111,40 per barel** menjadi sekitar **US$126,70 per barel**.
segments.tr: The MOPS benchmark price is estimated to rise from around **US$111.40 per barrel** to approximately **US$126.70 per barrel**.

segments.src: Selisihnya sekitar US$15 per barel, atau kenaikan kurang lebih 14 persen.
segments.tr: The difference is about US$15 per barrel, or an increase of roughly 14 percent.

segments.src: Karena Indonesia masih mengandalkan sebagian pasokan produk BBM dan minyak mentah dari pasar internasional, pergerakan harga di Singapura sebagai pusat perdagangan minyak Asia kerap memengaruhi harga jual di dalam negeri.
segments.tr: Because Indonesia still relies on some supply of fuel products and crude oil from the international market, price movements in Singapore as the center of Asian oil trading often affect domestic selling prices.

segments.src: ## Proyeksi Harga BBM Nonsubsidi
segments.tr: ## Non-Subsidized Fuel Price Projections

segments.src: Berdasarkan proyeksi tersebut, beberapa jenis BBM nonsubsidi diperkirakan berubah sebagai berikut.
segments.tr: Based on these projections, several types of non-subsidized fuel are estimated to change as follows.

segments.src: | Jenis BBM | Proyeksi Harga Oktober |
segments.tr: | Fuel Type | October Price Projection |

segments.src: | Pertamax Green 95 | sekitar Rp21.200 per liter |
segments.tr: | Pertamax Green 95 | around Rp21,200 per liter |

segments.src: | Dexlite | sekitar Rp25.000 per liter |
segments.tr: | Dexlite | around Rp25,000 per liter |

segments.src: | Pertamax | diperkirakan tetap |
segments.tr: | Pertamax | estimated to remain unchanged |

segments.src: | BBM subsidi | diperkirakan tetap |
segments.tr: | Subsidized fuel | estimated to remain unchanged |

segments.src: Kenaikan tertinggi yang disebut dalam proyeksi ini mencapai sekitar 11 persen.
segments.tr: The highest increase mentioned in this projection reaches about 11 percent.

segments.src: Besarannya bisa berbeda untuk tiap jenis BBM, bergantung pada spesifikasi produk dan komponen biaya masing-masing.
segments.tr: The amount may vary for each type of fuel, depending on product specifications and respective cost components.

segments.src: Perlu dicatat, harga final di setiap wilayah dapat berbeda karena adanya perbedaan pajak daerah dan biaya distribusi.
segments.tr: It should be noted that the final price in each region may differ due to differences in local taxes and distribution costs.

segments.src: Harga resmi biasanya diumumkan badan usaha, dalam hal ini Pertamina, pada awal periode penyesuaian.
segments.tr: Official prices are usually announced by the business entity, in this case Pertamina, at the beginning of the adjustment period.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Harga Minyak Singapura Berpengaruh?
segments.tr: ## Why Do Singapore Oil Prices Matter?

segments.src: Harga BBM nonsubsidi tidak ditetapkan secara sembarangan.
segments.tr: Non-subsidized fuel prices are not set arbitrarily.

segments.src: Secara umum, harga jual dipengaruhi beberapa komponen:
segments.tr: In general, selling prices are influenced by several components:

segments.src: - **Harga acuan produk (MOPS atau indeks setara):** menjadi dasar biaya pengadaan BBM.
segments.tr: - **Product benchmark price (MOPS or equivalent index):** serves as the basis for fuel procurement costs.

segments.src: - **Nilai tukar rupiah terhadap dolar AS:** karena transaksi minyak menggunakan dolar, pelemahan rupiah dapat menambah biaya.
segments.tr: - **Rupiah exchange rate against the US dollar:** because oil transactions use dollars, the weakening of the rupiah can increase costs.

segments.src: - **Biaya distribusi dan penyimpanan:** mencakup pengangkutan hingga sampai ke SPBU.
segments.tr: - **Distribution and storage costs:** covers transportation until it reaches the gas station.

segments.src: - **Pajak dan margin badan usaha:** termasuk pajak pertambahan nilai dan pajak bahan bakar kendaraan bermotor.
segments.tr: - **Taxes and business entity margins:** including value-added tax and motor vehicle fuel tax.

segments.src: Ketika harga acuan naik cukup tajam dalam waktu singkat, tekanan terhadap harga jual pun ikut membesar, terutama pada produk yang harganya mengikuti mekanisme pasar.
segments.tr: When the benchmark price rises quite sharply in a short time, pressure on the selling price also increases, especially for products whose prices follow market mechanisms.

segments.src: ## Pertamax dan BBM Subsidi Diperkirakan Tetap
segments.tr: ## Pertamax and Subsidized Fuel Estimated to Remain Unchanged

segments.src: Kabar yang relatif melegakan bagi banyak pengguna kendaraan adalah bahwa **Pertamax dan BBM subsidi diperkirakan tidak berubah**.
segments.tr: Relatively comforting news for many vehicle users is that **Pertamax and subsidized fuel are projected not to change**.

segments.src: BBM subsidi memang memiliki mekanisme penetapan harga yang berbeda, karena pemerintah ikut menentukan harga eceran serta menanggung selisihnya melalui anggaran negara.
segments.tr: Subsidized fuel indeed has a different pricing mechanism, because the government helps determine the retail price and covers the difference through the state budget.

segments.src: Meski demikian, proyeksi ini belum menjelaskan secara rinci alasan Pertamax dipertahankan.
segments.tr: Even so, this projection does not explain in detail the reasons Pertamax is maintained.

segments.src: Konsumen sebaiknya menunggu keterangan resmi dari Pertamina atau pemerintah sebelum mengambil kesimpulan.
segments.tr: Consumers should wait for official statements from Pertamina or the government before drawing conclusions.

segments.src: ## Sorotan pada Selat Hormuz dan Laut Merah
segments.tr: ## Spotlight on the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea

segments.src: Selat Hormuz dan Laut Merah merupakan jalur pelayaran strategis bagi perdagangan energi dan barang dunia.
segments.tr: The Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea are strategic shipping lanes for world energy and goods trade.

segments.src: Ketika terjadi ketegangan di kawasan tersebut, pasar biasanya bereaksi terhadap risiko gangguan pasokan.
segments.tr: When tensions occur in the region, the market usually reacts to the risk of supply disruptions.

segments.src: Reaksi itu bisa berupa kenaikan harga minyak, kenaikan tarif asuransi kapal, atau perubahan rute pelayaran yang membuat waktu tempuh dan biaya kirim bertambah.
segments.tr: That reaction can be in the form of rising oil prices, higher ship insurance rates, or changes in shipping routes that increase travel time and shipping costs.

segments.src: Kondisi ini membuat pelaku usaha di bidang transportasi dan logistik ikut menyoroti perkembangan harga BBM.
segments.tr: This condition causes business actors in the transportation and logistics sectors to highlight fuel price developments.

segments.src: Bagi mereka, bahan bakar merupakan salah satu komponen biaya terbesar.
segments.tr: For them, fuel is one of the largest cost components.

segments.src: Kenaikan harga solar nonsubsidi seperti Dexlite berpotensi menambah beban operasional angkutan barang, terutama bagi perusahaan yang tidak menggunakan BBM bersubsidi.
segments.tr: The price increase of non-subsidized diesel such as Dexlite has the potential to add to the operational burden of freight transport, especially for companies that do not use subsidized fuel.

segments.src: ## Dampak yang Perlu Diantisipasi
segments.tr: ## Impacts to Anticipate

segments.src: Beberapa hal yang patut dicermati bila proyeksi ini terealisasi:
segments.tr: Several things worth watching if this projection is realized:

segments.src: 1. **Ongkos angkut barang:** biaya logistik yang naik dapat memengaruhi harga barang, meski besarnya tergantung sektor dan jarak pengiriman.
segments.tr: 1. **Freight transport costs:** rising logistics costs can affect goods prices, although the magnitude depends on the sector and delivery distance.

segments.src: 2. **Biaya operasional usaha kecil:** pelaku usaha yang bergantung pada armada kendaraan perlu meninjau ulang perhitungan biaya.
segments.tr: 2. **Small business operational costs:** business actors who rely on vehicle fleets need to review their cost calculations.

segments.src: 3. **Pengeluaran rumah tangga:** pengguna BBM nonsubsidi mungkin perlu menyesuaikan anggaran transportasi bulanan.
segments.tr: 3. **Household expenditures:** non-subsidized fuel users may need to adjust their monthly transportation budget.

segments.src: 4. **Inflasi:** kenaikan biaya transportasi dan logistik bisa memberi tekanan tambahan pada harga kebutuhan sehari-hari, meski dampak akhirnya masih bergantung pada kebijakan dan kondisi pasar.
segments.tr: 4. **Inflation:** rising transportation and logistics costs can put additional pressure on daily necessities prices, although the final impact still depends on policy and market conditions.

segments.src: ## Tips Menyikapi Kenaikan Harga BBM
segments.tr: ## Tips for Addressing Fuel Price Increases

segments.src: Bagi masyarakat dan pelaku usaha, ada beberapa langkah sederhana yang dapat dipertimbangkan:
segments.tr: For the community and business actors, there are several simple steps that can be considered:

segments.src: - **Pantau pengumuman resmi** Pertamina dan pemerintah agar tidak terpengaruh kabar yang belum terverifikasi.
segments.tr: - **Monitor official announcements** from Pertamina and the government so as not to be affected by unverified news.

segments.src: - **Gunakan BBM sesuai spesifikasi kendaraan.** Jangan berpindah jenis BBM hanya karena selisih harga bila tidak sesuai rekomendasi pabrikan.
segments.tr: - **Use fuel according to vehicle specifications.** Do not change fuel types just because of price differences if it does not match manufacturer recommendations.

segments.src: - **Rawat kendaraan secara berkala,** seperti mengecek tekanan ban dan filter udara, agar konsumsi bahan bakar tetap efisien.
segments.tr: - **Maintain the vehicle regularly,** such as checking tire pressure and air filters, so that fuel consumption remains efficient.

segments.src: - **Rencanakan perjalanan dan rute pengiriman** agar lebih hemat waktu dan bahan bakar.
segments.tr: - **Plan trips and shipping routes** to save time and fuel.

segments.src: - **Tinjau kembali anggaran usaha** bila BBM merupakan komponen biaya yang besar.
segments.tr: - **Review business budgets** if fuel is a major cost component.

segments.src: ## Catatan Penting
segments.tr: ## Important Note

segments.src: Angka-angka dalam artikel ini merupakan **proyeksi** yang dapat berubah mengikuti pergerakan harga minyak dunia, nilai tukar rupiah, dan kebijakan pemerintah.
segments.tr: The figures in this article are **projections** that can change following world oil price movements, rupiah exchange rates, and government policies.

segments.src: Pembaca disarankan merujuk langsung pada pengumuman resmi Pertamina serta kanal resmi pemerintah untuk mengetahui harga yang berlaku.
segments.tr: Readers are advised to refer directly to Pertamina's official announcements and official government channels to find out the applicable prices.

segments.src: Artikel ini disusun untuk tujuan informasi umum dan bukan merupakan saran keuangan atau investasi.
segments.tr: This article is prepared for general information purposes and does not constitute financial or investment advice.

id-20260927-news-3.title: Indonesian Delegation Walks Out During Netanyahu's Speech at UN General Assembly, 77 Nations Join in Leaving the Room

segments.src: Delegasi Indonesia meninggalkan ruang sidang Majelis Umum PBB ke-81 di New York ketika Perdana Menteri Israel Benjamin Netanyahu naik podium untuk berpidato pada Kamis, 24 September 2026 waktu setempat.
segments.tr: The Indonesian delegation left the hall of the 81st session of the UN General Assembly in New York when Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu took the podium to speak on Thursday, September 24, 2026, local time.

segments.src: Indonesia tidak sendiri.
segments.tr: Indonesia was not alone.

segments.src: Puluhan delegasi negara lain juga meninggalkan ruangan atau tidak hadir.
segments.tr: Dozens of delegations from other countries also left the room or were absent.

segments.src: Kementerian Luar Negeri (Kemlu) RI kemudian menjelaskan bahwa langkah itu merupakan bentuk solidaritas terhadap rakyat Palestina.
segments.tr: The Indonesian Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA) later explained that the move was a form of solidarity with the Palestinian people.

segments.src: ## Apa yang terjadi di ruang sidang
segments.tr: ## What happened in the courtroom

segments.src: Netanyahu mulai berpidato dalam rangkaian debat umum Sidang Majelis Umum PBB ke-81.
segments.tr: Netanyahu began his speech during the general debate of the 81st session of the UN General Assembly.

segments.src: Begitu ia berdiri di podium, sejumlah delegasi berjalan keluar, sehingga banyak kursi di aula tampak kosong.
segments.tr: As soon as he stood at the podium, a number of delegations walked out, leaving many seats in the hall looking empty.

segments.src: Kursi delegasi Indonesia termasuk di antaranya.
segments.tr: The seats of the Indonesian delegation were among them.

segments.src: Jumlah negara yang keluar berbeda-beda di setiap laporan:
segments.tr: The number of countries that walked out varies in each report:

segments.src: - Sejumlah media nasional, di antaranya IDX Channel dan AFU.id, menyebut **77 delegasi**, yaitu Indonesia bersama 76 negara lain.
segments.tr: - Several national media outlets, including IDX Channel and AFU.id, cited **77 delegations**, namely Indonesia along with 76 other countries.

segments.src: - Kantor berita Anadolu, yang dikutip banyak media, menyebut **sekitar 70 delegasi**. Hitungan itu berdasarkan tinjauan rekaman sidang.
segments.tr: - Anadolu news agency, cited by many media outlets, mentioned **around 70 delegations**. That count is based on a review of session recordings.

segments.src: Perbedaan angka ini umum terjadi.
segments.tr: This difference in numbers is common.

segments.src: Sebagian delegasi walkout saat pidato dimulai, sebagian lain memang tidak mengirim perwakilan.
segments.tr: Some delegations walked out when the speech began, while others did not send representatives at all.

segments.src: Pembaca sebaiknya melihat angka tersebut sebagai perkiraan.
segments.tr: Readers should view these figures as estimates.

segments.src: Catatan resmi PBB tidak memuat hitungan pasti.
segments.tr: Official UN records do not contain an exact count.

segments.src: ## Negara mana saja yang keluar
segments.tr: ## Which countries walked out

segments.src: Menurut hasil tinjauan Anadolu, delegasi yang meninggalkan ruangan atau tidak hadir antara lain Turki, Palestina, Tunisia, Suriah, Aljazair, Yaman, Mesir, Irak, Arab Saudi, Yordania, Iran, Qatar, Lebanon, Malaysia, Indonesia, dan Kuwait.
segments.tr: According to Anadolu's review, delegations that left the room or were absent included Turkey, Palestine, Tunisia, Syria, Algeria, Yemen, Egypt, Iraq, Saudi Arabia, Jordan, Iran, Qatar, Lebanon, Malaysia, Indonesia, and Kuwait.

segments.src: Dari luar kawasan Timur Tengah ada Spanyol, Brasil, Peru, Kuba, Nigeria, Ghana, Libya, Bangladesh, Afghanistan, Oman, Niger, Madagaskar, Botswana, Bahama, Antigua dan Barbuda, serta Cabo Verde.
segments.tr: From outside the Middle East region were Spain, Brazil, Peru, Cuba, Nigeria, Ghana, Libya, Bangladesh, Afghanistan, Oman, Niger, Madagascar, Botswana, the Bahamas, Antigua and Barbuda, and Cabo Verde.

segments.src: Sebaliknya, banyak negara tetap berada di ruangan.
segments.tr: Conversely, many countries remained in the room.

segments.src: Laporan yang sama menyebut Amerika Serikat, Jerman, Inggris, Prancis, Argentina, Hungaria, Kanada, Australia, dan sejumlah negara Eropa lain.
segments.tr: The same report mentioned the United States, Germany, the United Kingdom, France, Argentina, Hungary, Canada, Australia, and a number of other European countries.

segments.src: Tiongkok disebut hanya diwakili satu diplomat.
segments.tr: China was reportedly represented by only one diplomat.

segments.src: Peta ini menunjukkan bahwa sikap negara-negara anggota PBB terhadap isu Gaza masih beragam.
segments.tr: This map shows that UN member states' attitudes toward the Gaza issue remain diverse.

segments.src: ## Penjelasan Kemlu RI
segments.tr: ## Explanation from the Indonesian Ministry of Foreign Affairs

segments.src: Juru bicara Kemlu RI, Vahd Nabyl A.
segments.tr: MoFA spokesperson Vahd Nabyl A.

segments.src: Mulachela, menjelaskan bahwa aksi tersebut dilakukan **"sebagai bentuk solidaritas kepada rakyat Palestina serta protes dan kecaman terhadap kejahatan kemanusiaan dan pelanggaran hukum internasional"** yang, menurut pemerintah Indonesia, dilakukan Israel terhadap warga Palestina di Gaza dan di Wilayah Palestina yang diduduki.
segments.tr: Mulachela, explained that the action was carried out **"as a form of solidarity with the Palestinian people as well as a protest and condemnation of crimes against humanity and violations of international law"** which, according to the Indonesian government, Israel has committed against Palestinians in Gaza and in the Occupied Palestinian Territory.

segments.src: Beberapa hal penting dari penjelasan tersebut:
segments.tr: Several key points from the explanation:

segments.src: 1. **Bentuk protes yang damai dan lazim.** Walkout adalah praktik diplomatik yang sudah lama dikenal di forum internasional. Delegasi menyampaikan sikap politik tanpa mengganggu jalannya sidang.
segments.tr: 1. **A peaceful and common form of protest.** A walkout is a diplomatic practice long known in international forums. Delegations express their political stance without disrupting the proceedings.

segments.src: 2. **Konsisten dengan posisi lama Indonesia.** Indonesia sejak lama mendukung kemerdekaan Palestina dan menyuarakan penyelesaian konflik berdasarkan hukum internasional. Indonesia juga tidak memiliki hubungan diplomatik dengan Israel.
segments.tr: 2. **Consistent with Indonesia's longstanding position.** Indonesia has long supported Palestinian independence and voiced the resolution of the conflict based on international law. Indonesia also has no diplomatic relations with Israel.

segments.src: 3. **Bagian dari agenda yang lebih luas.** Delegasi Indonesia di UNGA81 dipimpin Menteri Luar Negeri Sugiono. Dalam rangkaian agenda itu, Indonesia dilaporkan mengumumkan bantuan sebesar USD 1,2 juta (sekitar Rp21,4 miliar) untuk UNRWA, badan PBB untuk pengungsi Palestina, serta menegaskan dukungan bagi pemulihan Gaza.
segments.tr: 3. **Part of a broader agenda.** The Indonesian delegation at UNGA81 was led by Foreign Minister Sugiono. In the series of agendas, Indonesia reportedly announced assistance of USD 1.2 million (around Rp21.4 billion) for UNRWA, the UN agency for Palestine refugees, and reaffirmed support for the recovery of Gaza.

segments.src: ## Tanggapan Netanyahu
segments.tr: ## Netanyahu's Response

segments.src: Menurut laporan media internasional, Netanyahu menanggapi delegasi yang keluar dari podium.
segments.tr: According to international media reports, Netanyahu responded to the delegations leaving the podium.

segments.src: Ia menyebut pihak yang meninggalkan ruangan sebagai "pengecut moral".
segments.tr: He called those who left the room "moral cowards".

segments.src: Dalam pidatonya, ia juga dilaporkan membela operasi militer Israel dan menolak tuduhan genosida di Gaza.
segments.tr: In his speech, he was also reported to have defended Israel's military operations and rejected accusations of genocide in Gaza.

segments.src: Pihak yang mengkritik Israel dan pihak yang membelanya memiliki pandangan yang sangat berbeda.
segments.tr: Those who criticize Israel and those who defend it hold vastly different views.

segments.src: Tuduhan kedua belah pihak ini sebaiknya dibaca sebagai pernyataan masing-masing, bukan sebagai kesimpulan hukum.
segments.tr: These mutual accusations should be read as respective statements, not as legal conclusions.

segments.src: Penilaian hukum atas situasi di Gaza masih menjadi pokok perkara di lembaga peradilan internasional.
segments.tr: A legal assessment of the situation in Gaza remains the subject of proceedings in international judicial institutions.

segments.src: ## Agenda berikutnya: pernyataan nasional Menlu Sugiono
segments.tr: ## Next agenda: Foreign Minister Sugiono's national statement

segments.src: Setelah walkout, perhatian beralih ke pernyataan nasional Indonesia dalam debat umum.
segments.tr: Following the walkout, attention shifted to Indonesia's national statement in the general debate.

segments.src: Menlu Sugiono dijadwalkan menyampaikan pernyataan itu pada 26 September, dengan tema perdamaian dunia.
segments.tr: Foreign Minister Sugiono is scheduled to deliver the statement on September 26, themed around world peace.

segments.src: Dalam berbagai kesempatan di UNGA81, Sugiono menyampaikan bahwa perdamaian harus disertai perubahan nyata bagi masyarakat Palestina, termasuk akses bantuan kemanusiaan dan berakhirnya kekerasan di Gaza.
segments.tr: In various occasions at UNGA81, Sugiono stated that peace must be accompanied by real change for the Palestinian people, including access to humanitarian aid and an end to the violence in Gaza.

segments.src: Pernyataan nasional adalah kesempatan bagi setiap negara untuk menyampaikan pandangan resmi tentang isu global, dari konflik bersenjata hingga kerja sama pembangunan.
segments.tr: A national statement is an opportunity for every country to convey its official views on global issues, from armed conflict to development cooperation.

segments.src: Isi lengkapnya bisa dibaca di situs resmi Kemlu RI dan di rilis resmi PBB.
segments.tr: The full content can be read on the official website of the Indonesian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and in official UN releases.

segments.src: ## Apa artinya bagi pembaca
segments.tr: ## What it means for readers

segments.src: - **Walkout bukan keputusan hukum.** Aksi ini adalah pesan politik dan tidak mengubah status hukum atau kebijakan apa pun.
segments.tr: - **A walkout is not a legal decision.** This action is a political message and does not change any legal status or policy.

segments.src: - **Posisi Indonesia tidak berubah.** Langkah ini sejalan dengan sikap Indonesia yang selama ini mendukung Palestina lewat jalur diplomasi dan bantuan kemanusiaan.
segments.tr: - **Indonesia's position remains unchanged.** This step aligns with Indonesia's stance of supporting Palestine through diplomatic channels and humanitarian aid.

segments.src: - **Dunia belum satu suara.** Ada negara yang keluar dan ada yang tetap duduk. Perbedaan itu menunjukkan bahwa isu Timur Tengah masih diperdebatkan.
segments.tr: - **The world is not yet of one voice.** Some countries walked out while others remained seated. This difference shows that the Middle East issue is still fiercely debated.

segments.src: - **Pantau sumber resmi.** Angka dan detail bisa berubah seiring verifikasi, jadi rujuklah keterangan resmi Kemlu RI dan PBB.
segments.tr: - **Monitor official sources.** Figures and details may change with verification, so refer to official statements from the Indonesian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the UN.

segments.src: ## Catatan sumber
segments.tr: ## Source notes

segments.src: Artikel ini disusun dari laporan media nasional dan internasional, antara lain Republika, Suara.com, IDX Channel, Jawa Pos, Liputan6, Antara, Anadolu, The Express Tribune, dan Al Jazeera, serta keterangan Kemlu RI yang dikutip media tersebut.
segments.tr: This article was compiled from national and international media reports, including Republika, Suara.com, IDX Channel, Jawa Pos, Liputan6, Antara, Anadolu, The Express Tribune, and Al Jazeera, as well as statements from the Indonesian Ministry of Foreign Affairs quoted by those media.

segments.src: Informasi bersifat umum dan tidak dimaksudkan sebagai pendapat politik atau nasihat hukum.
segments.tr: The information is general in nature and is not intended as political opinion or legal advice.

segments.src: Situasi dapat berkembang, jadi periksa pembaruan dari sumber resmi.
segments.tr: The situation may evolve, so check for updates from official sources.

segments.tr: > Advanced merchandising is not about arranging shelves, but about answering three questions at once: what category do we sell, how much stock do we hold, and what price do we set.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: Di edisi sebelumnya kita membahas dasar merchandising: barang yang tepat, di tempat yang tepat, pada waktu yang tepat.
segments.tr: In the previous edition we discussed merchandising basics: the right goods, in the right place, at the right time.

segments.src: Sekarang kita masuk ke ruang mesinnya.
segments.tr: Now we enter the engine room.

segments.src: Ada tiga tuas yang dipakai peritel profesional, dan ketiganya saling menarik.
segments.tr: There are three levers used by professional retailers, and all three pull against each other.

segments.src: Category management — mengelola kategori seperti bisnis kecil.**
segments.tr: Category management — managing a category like a small business.**

segments.src: Peritel modern tidak menghitung untung per barang satuan, melainkan per *kategori*: "minuman siap minum", "perawatan rambut", "mi instan".
segments.tr: Modern retailers don't calculate profit per individual item, but per *category*: "ready-to-drink beverages", "hair care", "instant noodles".

segments.src: Setiap kategori diberi peran yang berbeda:
segments.tr: Each category is given a different role:

segments.src: - **Destination** — alasan orang datang ke toko Anda (misal: kopi sachet di minimarket dekat kampus).
segments.tr: - **Destination** — the reason people come to your store (e.g.: sacheted coffee at a convenience store near campus).

segments.src: - **Routine** — belanja rutin yang menjaga margin harian (sabun, deterjen).
segments.tr: - **Routine** — routine shopping that maintains daily margin (soap, detergent).

segments.src: - **Seasonal** — musiman (parsel Lebaran, perlengkapan sekolah bulan Juli).
segments.tr: - **Seasonal** — seasonal items (Eid hampers, school supplies in July).

segments.src: - **Convenience** — pelengkap agar pembeli tidak perlu mampir ke toko lain (baterai, korek api).
segments.tr: - **Convenience** — add-ons so buyers don't need to visit another store (batteries, matches).

segments.src: Perannya menentukan sisanya: kategori destination boleh dijual tipis untuk menarik orang; kategori convenience boleh bermargin tebal karena pembeli membelinya karena kepepet, bukan karena harga.
segments.tr: Its role determines the rest: destination categories can be sold with thin margins to attract people; convenience categories can have thick margins because buyers purchase them out of necessity, not because of price.

segments.src: Manajemen persediaan — stok adalah uang yang sedang diam.**
segments.tr: Inventory management — stock is money sitting still.**

segments.src: Setiap rupiah yang menumpuk di gudang tidak bisa dipakai untuk hal lain.
segments.tr: Every rupiah piling up in the warehouse can't be used for anything else.

segments.src: Maka ukurannya bukan "berapa banyak stok", tapi "berapa cepat stok berputar" dan "berapa laba yang dihasilkan tiap rupiah stok".
segments.tr: So the measure isn't "how much stock", but "how fast stock turns over" and "how much profit is generated per rupiah of stock".

segments.src: Perputaran persediaan = HPP dalam periode / rata-rata nilai persediaan
segments.tr: Perputaran persediaan = HPP dalam periode / rata-rata nilai persediaan

segments.src: GMROI = margin kotor (Rp) / rata-rata nilai persediaan (Rp, harga pokok)
segments.tr: GMROI = margin kotor (Rp) / rata-rata nilai persediaan (Rp, harga pokok)

segments.src: Titik pesan ulang = (permintaan harian rata-rata x lead time) + stok pengaman
segments.tr: Titik pesan ulang = (permintaan harian rata-rata x lead time) + stok pengaman

segments.src: GMROI adalah alat pendamai antara bagian pembelian yang mengejar margin dan bagian keuangan yang mengejar arus kas.
segments.tr: GMROI is a peacemaker between the purchasing team chasing margin and the finance team chasing cash flow.

segments.src: Barang bermargin tipis tapi berputar kencang sering mengalahkan barang bermargin tebal yang mengendap.
segments.tr: Items with thin margins but fast turnover often beat items with thick margins that pile up.

segments.src: Kebijakan harga — harga adalah pesan, bukan cuma angka.**
segments.tr: Pricing policy — price is a message, not just a number.**

segments.src: Dua mazhab besar: **EDLP** (*everyday low price*, harga stabil rendah, promo minim) dan **High-Low** (harga normal lebih tinggi, diselingi promo tajam).
segments.tr: Two major schools: **EDLP** (*everyday low price*, stable low prices, minimal promotions) and **High-Low** (higher normal prices, interrupted by sharp promotions).

segments.src: EDLP menghemat biaya operasional dan menenangkan permintaan; High-Low menciptakan alasan untuk datang lagi.
segments.tr: EDLP saves operating costs and stabilizes demand; High-Low creates a reason to come back.

segments.src: Yang paling menentukan citra harga sebuah toko adalah **KVI** (*key value items*) — segelintir barang yang harganya diingat pelanggan: air mineral, telur, beras, gula, mi instan.
segments.tr: What most determines a store's price image is **KVI** (*key value items*) — a handful of items whose prices customers remember: mineral water, eggs, rice, sugar, instant noodles.

segments.src: Kalau lima barang ini terasa murah, seluruh toko terasa murah.
segments.tr: If these five items feel cheap, the entire store feels cheap.

segments.src: Sisanya jarang dibandingkan orang.
segments.tr: People rarely compare the rest.

segments.src: ## Dalam Keseharian
segments.tr: ## In Everyday Life

segments.src: Bu Sri punya minimarket di pinggir jalan raya di Bekasi.
segments.tr: Bu Sri owns a convenience store on the roadside in Bekasi.

segments.src: Bulan lalu ia bingung: sales kosmetik menawarkan rak krim wajah dengan iming-iming margin 30%, jauh di atas margin air mineral yang cuma 10%.
segments.tr: Last month she was confused: a cosmetics sales rep offered a face cream shelf with the promise of a 30% margin, far above the 10% margin on mineral water.

segments.src: Terdengar jelas lebih menguntungkan.
segments.tr: It sounded clearly more profitable.

segments.src: Ia lalu menghitung ulang, per bulan:
segments.tr: She then recalculated, per month:

segments.src: | | Air mineral | Perawatan wajah |
segments.tr: | | Mineral water | Face care |

segments.src: | Rata-rata stok (harga pokok) | Rp 4.500.000 | Rp 9.000.000 |
segments.tr: | Average stock (cost price) | Rp 4,500,000 | Rp 9,000,000 |

segments.src: Laba kotornya sama persis: tiga juta rupiah.
segments.tr: Gross profit was exactly the same: three million rupiah.

segments.src: Tapi untuk memanennya, air mineral hanya "mengunci" Rp 4,5 juta modal, sementara krim wajah mengunci Rp 9 juta.
segments.tr: But to harvest it, mineral water only "locked up" Rp 4.5 million in capital, while face cream locked up Rp 9 million.

segments.src: Tiap rupiah yang ditanam di air mineral bekerja dua kali lebih keras.
segments.tr: Every rupiah invested in mineral water works twice as hard.

segments.src: Belum lagi krim wajah punya tanggal kedaluwarsa dan risiko modelnya ketinggalan zaman.
segments.tr: Not to mention face cream has an expiration date and the risk that its style becomes outdated.

segments.src: Keputusan Bu Sri akhirnya:
segments.tr: Bu Sri's final decision:

segments.src: - **Peran kategori.** Air mineral dan mi instan ditetapkan sebagai kategori *destination* — ditaruh di ujung rak yang mudah dijangkau, stok jangan sampai kosong.
segments.tr: - **Category role.** Mineral water and instant noodles are designated as *destination* categories — placed at the end of easily reachable shelves, stock should never run out.

segments.src: - **Harga.** Air mineral 600 ml dijadikan KVI: dipasang Rp 3.500 dan tidak naik-turun, supaya pelanggan hafal dan menganggap tokonya murah. Krim wajah tetap dijual, tapi dalam varian yang lebih sedikit (SKU dipangkas dari 24 jadi 10), dengan harga normal tanpa perang diskon.
segments.tr: - **Price.** 600 ml mineral water is made into a KVI: priced at Rp 3,500 and kept constant, so customers remember and think the store is cheap. Face cream is still sold, but in fewer variants (SKU cut from 24 to 10), with normal pricing without discount wars.

segments.src: - **Stok.** Air mineral dipesan dua kali seminggu dengan stok pengaman untuk tiga hari, karena pengiriman dari distributor butuh dua hari dan permintaan melonjak saat cuaca panas. Krim wajah dipesan sebulan sekali saja.
segments.tr: - **Stock.** Mineral water is ordered twice a week with safety stock for three days, because delivery from the distributor takes two days and demand spikes in hot weather. Face cream is ordered only once a month.

segments.src: Tiga bulan kemudian omzetnya naik tipis, tapi uang di kasir terasa jauh lebih lega — karena modal tidak lagi tertidur di rak kosmetik.
segments.tr: Three months later her revenue rose slightly, but the cash at the register felt much more comfortable — because capital was no longer sleeping on the cosmetics shelf.

segments.src: Satu catatan penting untuk konteks Indonesia: sebagian barang punya **HET** (Harga Eceran Tertinggi) yang ditetapkan pemerintah, seperti MinyaKita, LPG 3 kg, dan pupuk bersubsidi.
segments.tr: One important note for the Indonesian context: some items have **HET** (Maximum Retail Price) set by the government, such as MinyaKita, 3 kg LPG, and subsidized fertilizer.

segments.src: Untuk barang-barang ini, kebijakan harga toko dibatasi aturan — bukan sekadar hitungan margin.
segments.tr: For these items, the store's pricing policy is limited by regulation — not just a margin calculation.

segments.src: ## Rangkuman 3 Baris
segments.tr: ## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. Kelola **kategori**, bukan barang satuan; peran kategori (destination, routine, seasonal, convenience) menentukan seberapa tebal margin dan seberapa mencolok penempatannya.
segments.tr: 1. Manage **categories**, not individual items; a category's role (destination, routine, seasonal, convenience) determines how thick the margin and how prominent the placement.

segments.src: 2. Stok yang menumpuk adalah kas yang mengendap — nilai kategori dengan **perputaran persediaan dan GMROI**, bukan hanya persentase margin.
segments.tr: 2. Stock that piles up is cash that sits idle — evaluate categories by **inventory turnover and GMROI**, not just margin percentage.

segments.src: 3. Citra harga toko dibentuk oleh **KVI**, segelintir barang yang harganya diingat pelanggan; sisa katalog punya ruang gerak jauh lebih longgar.
segments.tr: 3. A store's price image is shaped by **KVI**, a handful of items whose prices customers remember; the rest of the catalog has much more room to maneuver.

segments.src: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri
segments.tr: ## ✅ Self-Quiz

segments.src: **1.** Kategori A: margin kotor Rp 2 juta dengan rata-rata stok Rp 2 juta.
segments.tr: **1.** Category A: gross margin Rp 2 million with average stock Rp 2 million.

segments.src: Kategori B: margin kotor Rp 3 juta dengan rata-rata stok Rp 6 juta.
segments.tr: Category B: gross margin Rp 3 million with average stock Rp 6 million.

segments.src: Mana yang GMROI-nya lebih tinggi?
segments.tr: Which has the higher GMROI?

segments.src: a) Kategori A  b) Kategori B  c) Sama  d) Tidak bisa dihitung
segments.tr: a) Category A  b) Category B  c) Same  d) Can't be calculated

segments.src: **2.** Strategi **EDLP** mengandalkan promo diskon besar yang sering, sedangkan **High-Low** menjaga harga tetap stabil sepanjang tahun.
segments.tr: **2.** **EDLP** strategy relies on frequent large discount promotions, while **High-Low** keeps prices stable throughout the year.

segments.src: (O / X)
segments.tr: (T / F)

segments.src: **3.** Baterai dan korek api di minimarket paling tepat diberi peran kategori apa?
segments.tr: **3.** Batteries and matches at a convenience store are best given which category role?

segments.src: a) Destination  b) Convenience  c) Seasonal  d) Routine
segments.tr: a) Destination  b) Convenience  c) Seasonal  d) Routine

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Today's Terms

segments.src: - **Category management** — praktik mengelola satu kategori barang sebagai unit bisnis tersendiri, lengkap dengan peran, target, dan taktiknya.
segments.tr: - **Category management** — the practice of managing one category of goods as a separate business unit, complete with its role, targets, and tactics.

segments.src: - **GMROI** — margin kotor dibagi rata-rata nilai persediaan (harga pokok); mengukur berapa laba yang dihasilkan tiap rupiah modal stok.
segments.tr: - **GMROI** — gross margin divided by average inventory value (cost price); measures how much profit is generated per rupiah of stock capital.

segments.src: - **Stok pengaman (safety stock)** — cadangan tambahan untuk menyerap lonjakan permintaan atau keterlambatan pasokan.
segments.tr: - **Safety stock** — additional reserve to absorb demand spikes or supply delays.

segments.src: - **KVI (key value items)** — sedikit barang yang harganya diingat dan dibandingkan pelanggan, sehingga membentuk citra harga seluruh toko.
segments.tr: - **KVI (key value items)** — a few items whose prices are remembered and compared by customers, thus shaping the price image of the entire store.

segments.src: - **EDLP vs High-Low** — dua mazhab penetapan harga: harga rendah yang stabil versus harga normal lebih tinggi yang diselingi promo tajam.
segments.tr: - **EDLP vs High-Low** — two pricing philosophies: stable low prices versus higher normal prices interrupted by sharp promotions.

segments.tr: *Answers: 1) a — GMROI A = 2/2 = 1.0; GMROI B = 3/6 = 0.5.

segments.src: Margin rupiah B lebih besar, tapi modal yang dikunci dua kali lipat.
segments.tr: B's profit in rupiah is larger, but the capital locked up is twice as much.

segments.src: 2) X — terbalik: EDLP justru menjaga harga stabil rendah dengan promo minim, sedangkan High-Low mengandalkan siklus diskon.
segments.tr: 2) F — it's reversed: EDLP actually maintains low prices with minimal promotions, while High-Low relies on a cycle of discounts.

segments.src: 3) b — pembeli mengambilnya sebagai pelengkap saat sedang butuh, jarang membandingkan harga, jadi kategori ini boleh bermargin lebih tebal.*
segments.tr: 3) b — buyers pick them up as add-ons when they need them, rarely compare prices, so this category can have a thicker margin.*

id-20260927-news-2.title: Indonesia Signs UN Cyber Convention Along with 90 Other Parties, Serving as Basis for Cross-Border Fraud and Online Gambling Hunt

segments.src: Indonesia resmi menandatangani Konvensi PBB tentang Kejahatan Siber, perjanjian pertama di bawah kerangka Perserikatan Bangsa-Bangsa yang khusus mengatur pencegahan dan pemberantasan kejahatan di ruang digital.
segments.tr: Indonesia has officially signed the UN Convention on Cybercrime, the first treaty under the United Nations framework specifically regulating the prevention and combating of crimes in the digital space.

segments.src: Penandatanganan dilakukan Menteri Luar Negeri Sugiono pada Kamis (24/9/2026) di Markas Besar PBB, New York, Amerika Serikat, di sela pekan tingkat tinggi Sidang Majelis Umum PBB.
segments.tr: The signing was carried out by Foreign Minister Sugiono on Thursday (Sep 24, 2026) at the UN Headquarters in New York, United States, on the sidelines of the high-level week of the UN General Assembly.

segments.src: Langkah ini menempatkan Indonesia bersama 90 pihak lain yang sudah lebih dulu menandatangani konvensi tersebut.
segments.tr: This step places Indonesia alongside 90 other parties that have previously signed the convention.

segments.src: Dari jumlah itu, baru tiga pihak yang telah menuntaskan ratifikasi.
segments.tr: Out of that number, only three parties have completed ratification.

segments.src: Setelah tanda tangan, pemerintah kini menyiapkan proses ratifikasi agar aturan dalam konvensi dapat berlaku dalam hukum nasional.
segments.tr: Following the signature, the government is now preparing the ratification process so that the rules in the convention can take effect under national law.

segments.src: ## Apa itu Konvensi Siber PBB?
segments.tr: ## What is the UN Cyber Convention?

segments.src: Konvensi ini adalah kesepakatan global pertama yang dirancang untuk menyatukan cara negara-negara menangani kejahatan siber.
segments.tr: This convention is the first global agreement designed to unite how countries handle cybercrime.

segments.src: Selama ini, penanganan kasus lintas negara kerap tersendat karena perbedaan hukum, prosedur, dan kecepatan kerja antarnegara, sementara pelaku dapat beraksi dari mana saja dalam hitungan detik.
segments.tr: Hitherto, the handling of cross-border cases has often stalled due to differences in laws, procedures, and working speeds between countries, while perpetrators can operate from anywhere within seconds.

segments.src: Secara garis besar, konvensi ini mencakup beberapa hal:
segments.tr: Broadly speaking, this convention covers several matters:

segments.src: - **Kesamaan definisi tindak pidana siber**, sehingga perbuatan yang dianggap kejahatan di satu negara juga dikenali di negara lain.
segments.tr: - **Common definitions of cyber offenses**, so that acts considered crimes in one country are also recognized in another.

segments.src: - **Aturan pengumpulan dan pertukaran bukti elektronik**, misalnya data digital yang dibutuhkan penyidik dalam suatu perkara.
segments.tr: - **Rules for collecting and exchanging electronic evidence**, such as digital data needed by investigators in a case.

segments.src: - **Kerja sama internasional antarpenegak hukum**, termasuk bantuan hukum timbal balik dan jalur komunikasi yang bisa dihubungi setiap saat.
segments.tr: - **International law enforcement cooperation**, including mutual legal assistance and communication channels that can be reached at any time.

segments.src: - **Ketentuan perlindungan hak asasi manusia**, yang menjadi salah satu isu penting selama proses perundingan.
segments.tr: - **Human rights protection provisions**, which became one of the important issues during the negotiation process.

segments.src: ## Peran Indonesia sejak awal perundingan
segments.tr: ## Indonesia's Role Since the Beginning of Negotiations

segments.src: Menurut keterangan pemerintah, Indonesia terlibat aktif sejak Komite Ad Hoc perumus konvensi dibentuk pada 2019 hingga konvensi diadopsi pada 24 Desember 2024.
segments.tr: According to government statements, Indonesia has been actively involved since the Ad Hoc Committee drafting the convention was formed in 2019 until the convention was adopted on December 24, 2024.

segments.src: Diplomat Indonesia di Wina, tempat pusat kegiatan PBB untuk urusan kejahatan berada, disebut berperan sebagai perunding sekaligus rapporteur dalam proses tersebut.
segments.tr: Indonesian diplomats in Vienna, where the UN center for crime-related activities is located, were noted to have acted as negotiators as well as rapporteurs in the process.

segments.src: Sugiono menyebut konvensi ini penting untuk memperkuat upaya pencegahan dan pemidanaan kejahatan siber di tingkat nasional.
segments.tr: Sugiono stated that this convention is important to strengthen efforts in preventing and punishing cybercrime at the national level.

segments.src: Pemerintah juga menegaskan akan menyelaraskan ketentuan konvensi dengan peraturan perundang-undangan Indonesia.
segments.tr: The government also emphasized that it will align the convention's provisions with Indonesian laws and regulations.

segments.src: ## Sasaran: penipuan, judi daring, dan eksploitasi anak
segments.tr: ## Target: Fraud, Online Gambling, and Child Exploitation

segments.src: Pemerintah menempatkan konvensi ini sebagai landasan untuk memperkuat kerja sama penegak hukum melawan sejumlah kejahatan yang paling meresahkan masyarakat, yaitu:
segments.tr: The government positions this convention as a foundation to strengthen law enforcement cooperation against several crimes that are most troubling to society, namely:

segments.src: 1. **Penipuan daring (scam)**, mulai dari investasi palsu, phishing, hingga penipuan berkedok pekerjaan atau hadiah.
segments.tr: 1. **Online fraud (scams)**, ranging from fake investments, phishing, to job or prize scams.

segments.src: 2. **Judi daring**, yang jaringannya sering melibatkan server, pengelola, dan aliran dana di luar negeri.
segments.tr: 2. **Online gambling**, whose networks often involve servers, managers, and fund flows abroad.

segments.src: 3. **Konten eksploitasi seksual anak**, kejahatan serius yang penanganannya memerlukan pelacakan lintas yurisdiksi.
segments.tr: 3. **Child sexual exploitation content**, a serious crime whose handling requires cross-jurisdictional tracking.

segments.src: Ketiga jenis kejahatan itu punya kesamaan: pelaku, korban, server, dan uang hasil kejahatan sering berada di negara yang berbeda.
segments.tr: These three types of crimes share similarities: perpetrators, victims, servers, and crime proceeds are often located in different countries.

segments.src: Tanpa mekanisme kerja sama yang jelas, aparat kerap kesulitan meminta data, membekukan aset, atau menangkap pelaku di luar negeri.
segments.tr: Without clear cooperation mechanisms, authorities often struggle to request data, freeze assets, or arrest perpetrators abroad.

segments.src: Kerangka konvensi diharapkan mempercepat proses tersebut.
segments.tr: The convention framework is expected to accelerate this process.

segments.src: ## Kapan konvensi mulai berlaku?
segments.tr: ## When Will the Convention Take Effect?

segments.src: Konvensi tidak otomatis berlaku begitu ditandatangani.
segments.tr: The convention does not automatically take effect once signed.

segments.src: Aturannya baru efektif pada hari ke-90 setelah instrumen ratifikasi, penerimaan, atau aksesi dari negara ke-40 disimpan.
segments.tr: Its rules only become effective on the 90th day after the ratification, acceptance, or accession instrument from the 40th country is deposited.

segments.src: Karena baru tiga pihak yang meratifikasi, jalan menuju berlakunya konvensi masih panjang.
segments.tr: Since only three parties have ratified it, the road to the convention's entry into force is still long.

segments.src: Di Indonesia sendiri, pengesahan perjanjian internasional umumnya melalui pembahasan pemerintah bersama DPR, dalam bentuk undang-undang atau peraturan presiden sesuai materi perjanjiannya.
segments.tr: In Indonesia itself, the approval of international treaties generally goes through government discussions with the DPR, in the form of a law or presidential regulation according to the subject matter of the agreement.

segments.src: Setelah itu, pemerintah perlu menyusun atau menyesuaikan instrumen hukum nasional, termasuk aturan turunan dan prosedur teknis bagi aparat penegak hukum.
segments.tr: After that, the government needs to formulate or adjust national legal instruments, including derivative rules and technical procedures for law enforcement officials.

segments.src: ## Catatan: perlindungan hak dan privasi
segments.tr: ## Note: Rights and Privacy Protection

segments.src: Selama perundingan, sejumlah organisasi masyarakat sipil, kelompok pembela hak digital, dan pelaku industri teknologi mengingatkan bahwa kewenangan pengumpulan bukti elektronik harus dibatasi dengan jelas.
segments.tr: During the negotiations, several civil society organizations, digital rights advocacy groups, and tech industry players reminded that the authority to collect electronic evidence must be clearly limited.

segments.src: Kekhawatirannya, aturan yang terlalu luas dapat berdampak pada privasi dan kebebasan berekspresi.
segments.tr: The concern is that rules that are too broad could impact privacy and freedom of expression.

segments.src: Karena itu, cara Indonesia menerjemahkan konvensi ke dalam hukum nasional akan diperhatikan, terutama soal pengawasan yudisial, transparansi, dan perlindungan data pribadi.
segments.tr: Therefore, how Indonesia translates the convention into national law will be watched closely, especially regarding judicial oversight, transparency, and personal data protection.

segments.src: ## Apa artinya bagi masyarakat?
segments.tr: ## What Does This Mean for the Public?

segments.src: Dampak konvensi tidak akan terasa seketika, tetapi arahnya jelas: pelaku kejahatan siber semakin sulit berlindung di balik perbatasan negara.
segments.tr: The convention's impact will not be felt instantly, but the direction is clear: cybercriminals will find it increasingly difficult to hide behind national borders.

segments.src: Sambil menunggu, masyarakat tetap perlu waspada dengan langkah sederhana berikut:
segments.tr: While waiting, the public still needs to remain vigilant with the following simple steps:

segments.src: - **Jangan pernah membagikan kode OTP, PIN, atau kata sandi** kepada siapa pun, termasuk pihak yang mengaku petugas bank atau perusahaan.
segments.tr: - **Never share OTP codes, PINs, or passwords** with anyone, including those claiming to be bank or company officers.

segments.src: - **Curigai tawaran yang terlalu menggiurkan**, seperti keuntungan cepat, hadiah tak terduga, atau pekerjaan dengan gaji tidak masuk akal.
segments.tr: - **Be suspicious of offers that are too tempting**, such as quick profits, unexpected prizes, or jobs with unreasonable salaries.

segments.src: - **Periksa kebenaran informasi** melalui kanal resmi lembaga terkait sebelum mentransfer uang atau mengklik tautan.
segments.tr: - **Verify information** through official channels of relevant institutions before transferring money or clicking links.

segments.src: - **Hindari judi daring**. Selain melanggar hukum, praktik ini berisiko menjerat pengguna dalam utang dan kebocoran data pribadi.
segments.tr: - **Avoid online gambling**. Aside from breaking the law, this practice risks trapping users in debt and personal data leaks.

segments.src: - **Laporkan penipuan sesegera mungkin** ke bank atau penyedia layanan keuangan Anda, ke Indonesia Anti-Scam Centre (IASC) milik OJK, atau ke kanal pengaduan resmi pemerintah.
segments.tr: - **Report fraud as soon as possible** to your bank or financial service provider, to OJK's Indonesia Anti-Scam Centre (IASC), or to official government complaint channels.

segments.src: ## Yang perlu dipantau berikutnya
segments.tr: ## What to Monitor Next

segments.src: Beberapa hal layak diikuti dalam beberapa bulan ke depan: kapan pemerintah mengajukan rancangan pengesahan ke DPR, bagaimana penyesuaian dengan regulasi yang ada seperti UU ITE dan UU Pelindungan Data Pribadi, serta seberapa cepat jumlah negara peratifikasi bertambah hingga mencapai 40.
segments.tr: Several things are worth following in the coming months: when the government submits the ratification bill to the DPR, how it aligns with existing regulations such as the ITE Law and the Personal Data Protection Law, and how quickly the number of ratifying countries grows to reach 40.

segments.src: Bagi Indonesia, penandatanganan ini baru langkah awal.
segments.tr: For Indonesia, this signing is just the beginning.

segments.src: Efektivitasnya akan sangat bergantung pada kesiapan aturan domestik dan kapasitas aparat untuk menjalankannya.
segments.tr: Its effectiveness will heavily depend on the preparedness of domestic rules and the capacity of officials to implement them.

segments.src: *Artikel ini disusun berdasarkan pemberitaan ANTARA, RRI, dan keterangan resmi UNODC per 27 September 2026.
segments.tr: *This article was prepared based on reporting by ANTARA, RRI, and official UNODC statements as of September 27, 2026.

segments.src: Informasi dapat berkembang seiring proses ratifikasi.*
segments.tr: Information may develop along with the ratification process.*
